chrome-faithful#dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b397d8938349c21b2ee8.html
